purpose: Teach: 挙げる/鋭く/有権者/流入/伝染病/地形/能動/神宮

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、歴史的偉業を、本気で、絶対、挙げる、絶対、人物、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, the way you tackled historical achievements in your paper was genuinely impressive. I was really struck by the depth of it.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Steady eye contact. Slight forward lean on praise. Not effusive but genuinely impressed. Speaks like someone seeing careful scholarship.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。批評家が、本気で、絶対、鋭く、絶対、指摘、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you, Professor. I really benefited from the critical feedback—it pushed me to dig deeper into the research.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude with underlying relief. Respectful distance maintained. Thoughtful pauses between phrases. The careful politeness of someone who takes feedback seriously.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 若年、本気で、絶対、有権者、絶対、の、絶対、投票行動、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your section on young voters and their voting patterns was particularly thoughtful. That kind of analysis doesn't come easily.
lines.style: Genuine recognition. Slightly slower pace, landing on 'thoughtful' with care. The tone of someone noticing something most wouldn't. Warm but professional.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。移民の、本気で、絶対、流入、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I'm glad it landed. The research on immigration trends was challenging, but I wanted to understand it properly.
lines.style: Modest but sincere. No false self-deprecation. Steady voice. The cadence of someone who genuinely cared about getting it right, not just finishing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史的、本気で、絶対、伝染病、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And your historical epidemiology section—that was sophisticated work for this level. You didn't shy away from the complexity.
lines.style: Clear admiration in the voice. Slight emphasis on 'sophisticated.' Leaning in slightly as if sharing something important. The recognition of someone who knows good scholarship when they see it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。離島の、本気で、絶対、地形、絶対、分析、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. The geographic analysis of the remote islands took a lot of time, but it felt important to ground the argument there.
lines.style: Understated pride beneath humility. Deliberate pacing. Slight lift at 'important'—a moment of conviction showing through. Respectful but not self-effacing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、能動、絶対、的な、絶対、学習法、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: What really stood out was how you structured active learning throughout the research process itself. That's maturity.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. Slight pause before 'maturity.' Speaking as an educator recognizing growth. Genuine without being patronizing. Warm professional regard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。明治神宮の、本気で、絶対、神宮、絶対、参道、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I appreciate that. Visiting the Meiji Jingu grounds and studying the shrine approach in person helped me see what the sources couldn't quite capture.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. A small smile in the voice—the satisfaction of having done something right. Measured but with underlying warmth. Ends with calm closure, not seeking further validation.
